title: TTHE:固定分支角色与回滚闸门(移植)
note: 移植的是 TTHE 每轮的决策规则:按 DIVERSITY[round_index % 3] 轮转角色,有效性闸门或编辑失败时保留现任,合法子代交由平台测量。CLI 将四个内容列表写入 workspace/artifacts/proposal_card.json,editor 原样传回;端点仍可直接返回 proposal_card,直接字段优先。控制器补齐身份字段,现有卡片键集和类型校验不变。没有复现 G×R 同批候选池、agentic judge、transductive 评分协议及反译/蜕变一致性代理;没有 judge 的移植版不保证合法子代分数不退步。

deviations.what: The port proposes one challenger per invocation, without the `G x R` same-batch branch pool or agentic judge.
deviations.why: run.py calls the shared editor once and submits that challenger without a judge. Upstream optimize.py:381-420 maintains fixed branches; its judge re-runs and probes the database, rather than taking argmax(score). This port therefore cannot guarantee that an admitted child will not regress.

deviations.what: The port rejects missing or invalid cards and unusable edits before child measurement, and skips proposal generation when staged evidence contains no trace-backed failure.
deviations.why: validity_gate, the proposal-card gate and apply_edits return the incumbent with changed:false on rejection. They do not reproduce upstream optimize.py:404-406's loadability audit or the post-generation judge; rejected cards may already have spent a proposer call.

deviations.what: CLI proposal cards use workspace/artifacts/proposal_card.json; endpoint proposal_card remains supported and takes precedence when present.
deviations.why: Upstream text_to_sql/proposer.py:150-164,372-388 writes and reads a disk card containing controller identities and four lists. The port transports the four lists through editor artifacts and fills identities itself before the unchanged valid_proposal_card check. Artifact transport accepts only UTF-8 regular files, rejects symlinks and unsafe paths, and fails rather than truncating above 256 KiB per file or 1 MiB total. Artifact files alone do not count as harness edits.
